note: A draft written from the model's own parameter comments. The build and assembly order is not recorded anywhere else, so change this file to match how you actually work; the page reads it on every load.

steps.title: Confirm the board sizes
steps.why: These sizes are marked provisional, or 'verify on the UC-685 drawing', in the model. Measure the real board with calipers, enter each value with its slider, then tick it here.

steps.title: Confirm the posts and screw
steps.why: The post must clear the connector (its underside is 2.7 mm tall on the drawing's numbers, so the post must be at least that tall) and leave a wall around the screw's pilot hole. Check these on the real board.

steps.title: Confirm the housing and lens sizes
steps.why: The head sled is a placeholder (the shell front is 29.7 mm, the sled is 36 mm). Measure the housing front the sled slides into and the lens barrel the ring must clear.

steps.title: Check the model builds clean
steps.why: Every change you made reruns the timeline. The page shows any failed step in a red banner; none should be left before you print.

steps.title: Print the fit coupon first
steps.why: It stands for the 12 mm rail specimen, so a small, fast print tells you how this printer's tolerances land before the real parts are printed. Try it on the rail it stands for: tight, loose or right.

steps.title: Print the carrier alone
steps.why: Seat the real board on the posts: the holes line up, the connector clears and the board sits flat. Fix sizes now, before the other parts are printed.

steps.title: Print the rest
steps.why: Head sled, rear gate, stand, tilt knob and lens ring.

steps.title: Assemble and try the tilt
steps.why: Board onto the posts with M2 thread-forming screws into the pilot holes, then the sled, the gate and the stand. Move the tilt knob through its range and note anything that binds.
